/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ibne-al-hasan.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
head, body = original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
metadata, roman = head.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
changes = {
'Ek beta hai Hasan ek hai Husain': 'Ik beta hai Hasan ek hai Husain',
'Dono hai zehra ka dil ka chain': 'Donoṅ haiṅ Zehra ke dil ka chain',
'Pukari maa mere shahzaade': 'Pukaari maaṅ mere shahzaade',
'Ek ka janaza tiroṅ par aa gaya': 'Ik ka janaaza tiroṅ par aa gaya',
'Ek ke janaze par tiroṅ ki hai bauchaar': 'Ik ke janaaze par tiroṅ ki hai bauchaar',
'Boli ye ro kar maa ae mere nur-e-ain': 'Boli ye ro kar maaṅ ae mere nur-e-ain',
'Ek ka kafan haye khaake karbala hua': 'Ik ka kafan haye khaak-e-Karbala hua',
'Nure chashme ahmed zehra ke dil ka chain': 'Nur-e-chashm-e-Ahmad Zehra ke dil ka chain',
'Gham meiṅ shehzadoṅ ke khun roye mustufa': 'Gham mein shahzaadoṅ ke khun roye Mustafa',
'Hai hashr ka samaa barpa hai shor o shain': 'Hai hashr ka samaaṅ barpa hai shor o shain',
'Turbat e mujtaba teht e shams o qamar': 'Turbat-e-Mujtaba taht-e-shams o qamar',
'Laasha e shaahe diṅ aur jalti rayt par': 'Laasha-e-shaah-e-diṅ aur jalti ret par',
'Haye re haye re ye ghurbat e sibtain': 'Haye re haye re ye ghurbat-e-sibtain',
'Haye baade qaza tiroṅ ka silsila': 'Haye baad-e-qaza tiroṅ ka silsila',
'Dono ki laashoṅ ka manzar hai ek sa': 'Donoṅ ki laashoṅ ka manzar hai ek sa',
'Ummat ne kab diya aale nabi ko chain': 'Ummat ne kab diya aal-e-Nabi ko chain',
'Qalb e maula Hasan tukroṅ meiṅ bat gaya': 'Qalb-e-Maula Hasan tukroṅ mein bat gaya',
'Qalb e shaahe zaman zakhmoṅ se phat gaya': 'Qalb-e-shaah-e-zaman zakhmoṅ se phat gaya',
'Kehti rahi ye maa haye haye hasnain': 'Kehti rahi ye maaṅ haye haye Hasnain',
'Itrat pe royenge ye arz ye samaa': 'Itrat pe royeṅge ye arz ye samaaṅ',
'Royegi ta-abad tum dono ko ye maa': 'Roye gi ta abad tum donoṅ ko ye maaṅ',
'Dayam e gul figaar kaise paaye qaraar': 'Dayam-e-gul figaar kaise paaye qaraar',
'Chashme yazdaṅ lahu roti hai zaar zaar': 'Chashm-e-Yazdaaṅ lahu roti hai zaar zaar',
'Sunke sar e majlis ek dukhiya maa ke bain': 'Sun ke sar-e-majlis ek dukhiya maaṅ ke bain',
}
lines = [line[2:] for line in roman.splitlines()]
assert all(line in lines for line in changes)
source = body.decode().strip().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(source) and lines[0] == '1' and source[0] == '۱'
updated = [changes.get(line, line) for line in lines]
p.write_bytes((metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line for line in updated)).encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
saved_head, saved_body = p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
assert saved_body == body and saved_head.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0] == metadata
print(f'Audited {len(source)-1} verses, corrected {sum(a "'!= b for a,b in zip(lines, updated))} Roman lines.'"')
PY"
